name: nightly-prompts-cockpit
description: Cross-platform Electron Cockpit for Nightly Prompts

scripts.build: npm run build:vite && npm run build:electron
scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "vite" "cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron ."
scripts.start: npm run build && cross-env NODE_ENV=production electron .

author: chrys
